scope: North Texas (Wichita, Grayson, Parker, Hunt counties) - basic needs

records.name: Wichita Falls Area Food Bank
records.description_en: The food bank supplies more than 90 partner food pantries and runs mobile pantries, senior food boxes, and Kids Cafe meals.
records.description_es: El banco de comida surte a más de 90 despensas y organizaciones aliadas. También tiene despensas móviles, cajas de comida para personas mayores y comidas para niños (Kids Cafe).
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the food bank's 12-county area who need food, including Wichita County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida en los 12 condados que atiende el banco de comida, incluido el condado de Wichita.
records.how_to_apply: Call the food bank or download the pantry schedule on its Find Food page to find a pantry or mobile pantry near you.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al banco de comida o descargue el horario de despensas en su página “Find Food” para encontrar una despensa o despensa móvil cerca de usted.
records.notes: Serves Archer, Baylor, Clay, Foard, Haskell, Jack, Knox, Montague, Throckmorton, Wichita, Wilbarger and Young counties. Programs include Mobile Pantry (with United Regional), Senior boxes (CSFP), Kids Cafe, and a Farmers Market program for WIC participants and qualifying seniors. The main office is a distribution hub; people usually get food at partner pantries.

records.name: North Texas Food Bank - Pantry Network
records.description_en: The food bank works with nearly 500 partner food pantries and agencies and runs mobile food distributions.
records.description_es: El banco de comida trabaja con casi 500 despensas y organizaciones aliadas, y también reparte comida en despensas móviles.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who need food in the food bank's 12-county area, which includes Grayson and Hunt counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida en los 12 condados que atiende el banco de comida, incluidos Grayson y Hunt.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find a Food Pantry locator or mobile pantry schedule on the website, or call the food bank.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el buscador de despensas (Find a Food Pantry) o el calendario de despensas móviles en el sitio web, o llame al banco de comida.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:30 AM-4:30 PM; Saturday 8:30 AM-3:30 PM
records.notes: Service area: Dallas, Collin, Fannin, Rockwall, Hunt, Grayson, Kaufman, Ellis, Navarro, Lamar, Delta and Hopkins counties. The Plano address is the headquarters, not a local pantry; refer clients to a nearby partner pantry.

records.name: North Texas Food Bank SNAP and Benefits Application Help
records.description_en: Food bank staff help people apply for SNAP food benefits and other state and federal benefits.
records.description_es: El personal del banco de comida le ayuda a solicitar SNAP (estampillas de comida) y otros beneficios del estado y del gobierno federal.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of the food bank's service area, including Grayson and Hunt counties, who want help applying for benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el área del banco de comida, incluidos los condados de Grayson y Hunt, y que quieren ayuda para solicitar beneficios.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email the SNAP team, or fill out the online referral form, and staff will contact you.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un correo al equipo de SNAP, o llene el formulario en línea, y alguien se comunicará con usted.
records.notes: Email: snap@ntfb.org

records.name: Tarrant Area Food Bank - TAFB West
records.description_en: The food bank has a west branch in Weatherford and a Find Food Map to locate partner food pantries.
records.description_es: El banco de comida tiene una sucursal oeste en Weatherford y un mapa en línea para encontrar despensas de comida cercanas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Fort Worth area and surrounding counties who need food.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el área de Fort Worth y condados cercanos que necesitan comida.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find Food Map on the website to find a pantry near you, or call the main number.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el mapa “Find Food” en el sitio web para encontrar una despensa cerca de usted, o llame al número principal. Llame antes de ir para confirmar el horario.
records.notes: The TAFB West branch address is confirmed in Weatherford (Parker County), but the pages read did not list Parker County by name in the service area. The phone is the main Fort Worth line. The branch is a distribution site; clients should use the Find Food Map for pantries.

records.name: Manna Storehouse Food Pantry and Emergency Assistance
records.description_en: A volunteer-run food pantry that also gives emergency help with utility bills and prescriptions and runs a low-cost thrift store.
records.description_es: Despensa de comida atendida por voluntarios. También da ayuda de emergencia con recibos de luz y agua y con medicinas, y tiene una tienda de segunda mano a bajo costo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need who live in Parker County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias con necesidad que viven en el condado de Parker.
records.how_to_apply: Visit during client hours or call to ask for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya en el horario de atención o llame para pedir ayuda.
records.notes: Faith-based, all-volunteer nonprofit operating since 1986. The site does not list documents or formal eligibility rules; call ahead.

records.name: Utility Assistance Program (CEAP)
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay part of their electric, gas, or propane bills and teaches ways to save energy.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar parte de sus recibos de luz, gas o gas propano, y enseña cómo ahorrar energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Collin, Cooke, Denton, Fannin, Grayson, Hunt, or Rockwall County with income at or below 150% of the poverty level (for example, up to $49,500 a year for a family of 4).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos en los condados de Collin, Cooke, Denton, Fannin, Grayson, Hunt o Rockwall, con ingresos de hasta el 150% del nivel de pobreza (por ejemplo, hasta $49,500 al año para una familia de 4).
documents_needed: Photo ID for all household members
Birth certificates for all household members
Proof of income for the last 30 days (pay stubs, Social Security award letters, etc.)
Current utility bill (electric, gas, or propane)
records.how_to_apply: Get the application packet from the TCOG Energy Services page and mail it or drop it off at TCOG Energy Services, 1117 Gallagher Drive, Suite 200, Sherman, TX 75090. Applications are not accepted by email, fax, or online.
records.how_to_apply_es: Consiga la solicitud en la página de Energy Services de TCOG y envíela por correo o entréguela en TCOG Energy Services, 1117 Gallagher Drive, Suite 200, Sherman, TX 75090. No se aceptan solicitudes por correo electrónico, fax ni en línea.
records.notes: Phone extension 3541; email energyapp@tcog.com. Processing takes about 8 weeks, so apply early. This is not emergency help and cannot pay late fees, deposits, or reconnection fees; help depends on available funds.

records.name: Weatherization Assistance Program
records.description_en: Makes free energy-saving repairs and improvements to homes so utility bills go down.
records.description_es: Hace arreglos gratis en su casa para ahorrar energía, para que sus recibos de luz y gas bajen.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Cooke, Fannin, and Grayson counties; call to confirm eligibility.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos en los condados de Cooke, Fannin y Grayson. Llame para confirmar si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Download the weatherization application from the TCOG website or call TCOG Energy Services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud en el sitio web de TCOG o llame a TCOG Energy Services.
records.notes: Service area listed by TCOG: Cooke, Fannin, and Grayson counties. Toll-free (800) 677-8264.

records.name: Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher Program
records.description_en: Helps very low-income families, older adults, and people with disabilities pay rent so they pay no more than 40% of their income for rent and utilities.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de muy bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad a pagar la renta, para que no paguen más del 40% de su ingreso en renta y servicios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For very low-income families, older adults, and people with disabilities in Grayson and Fannin counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de muy bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad en los condados de Grayson y Fannin.
documents_needed: ID for all adults 18 and older
Proof of income (pay stubs, award letters, bank statements)
Proof of SNAP benefits, if you get them
records.how_to_apply: The regular (tenant-based) voucher waiting list is closed. You can apply for project-based vouchers in person at TCOG, 1117 Gallagher Drive, Suite 200, Sherman, from 8-11 AM or 1-4 PM, or call TCOG.
records.how_to_apply_es: La lista de espera para vales regulares está cerrada. Puede solicitar vales para viviendas específicas (project-based) en persona en TCOG, 1117 Gallagher Drive, Suite 200, Sherman, de 8 a 11 AM o de 1 a 4 PM, o llamar a TCOG.
records.cost: Free to apply; tenant pays part of rent
records.notes: Phone extension 3536; toll-free (800) 677-8264. Tenant-based voucher waiting list is CLOSED; project-based voucher lists are open in several cities. Project-based applications are also taken by Texoma Housing Partners (810 W 16th St, Bonham; 326 W Duke St, Howe).

records.name: Housing Choice Voucher Program (Section 8)
records.organization: City of Wichita Falls Development Services - Housing Division
records.description_en: Gives rental assistance to eligible residents, including project-based Section 8 rental help.
records.description_es: Da ayuda con la renta a residentes que califican, incluida la ayuda de Sección 8 para viviendas específicas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For eligible low-income residents of Wichita Falls; the program keeps a waiting list.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de bajos ingresos de Wichita Falls que califican. El programa tiene lista de espera.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Housing Division to ask about the waiting list and how to apply.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la División de Vivienda para preguntar por la lista de espera y cómo solicitar.
records.cost: Free to apply; tenant pays part of rent
records.notes: The Development Services department also runs a Minor/Emergency Home Repair Program and HOME program; Neighborhood Resources line is (940) 761-7448. City lists the address as 1300 7th Street, Wichita Falls, TX 76307-7531.

records.name: Homeless Prevention, Rapid Re-Housing and Supportive Housing
records.description_en: Offers homelessness prevention and rapid re-housing help, plus permanent supportive housing with case management for chronically homeless people with disabilities.
records.description_es: Ayuda a evitar que las personas se queden sin casa y a encontrar vivienda rápido. También ofrece vivienda permanente con apoyo de un trabajador de casos para personas con discapacidad que llevan mucho tiempo sin hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Nortex region who are homeless or at risk of losing housing; supportive housing is for chronically homeless individuals and families with a disability.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en la región de Nortex que no tienen hogar o que están en riesgo de perder su vivienda. La vivienda con apoyo es para personas y familias con discapacidad que llevan mucho tiempo sin hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Call Nortex or download the intake application from the Housing and HIV Services page.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Nortex o descargue la solicitud en la página de servicios de vivienda y VIH (Housing and HIV Services).
records.notes: Mailing: PO Box 5144, Wichita Falls, TX 76307. Prevention and rapid re-housing are funded through ESG (Emergency Solutions Grants). The full list of Nortex counties was not confirmed; Wichita County is the core.

records.name: Ryan White and HOPWA HIV Services
records.description_en: Helps people living with HIV get outpatient care, medicine, dental care, transportation, food, counseling, insurance co-pay help, and housing help (HOPWA).
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas que viven con VIH a recibir atención médica, medicinas, cuidado dental, transporte, comida, consejería, ayuda con copagos del seguro y ayuda con la vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For individuals and families affected by HIV in the Nortex region.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias afectadas por el VIH en la región de Nortex.
records.how_to_apply: Call Nortex or download the intake application and client questionnaire from the Housing and HIV Services page.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Nortex o descargue la solicitud y el cuestionario en la página de servicios de vivienda y VIH (Housing and HIV Services).

records.name: Faith Mission Men's Emergency Shelter
records.description_en: Emergency shelter open 365 days a year with beds, showers, meals, and clothing, plus case management and job readiness help.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia abierto los 365 días del año, con cama, regadera, comida y ropa. También da apoyo de un trabajador de casos y ayuda para prepararse para trabajar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For men who are homeless in Wichita Falls.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hombres sin hogar en Wichita Falls.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the shelter or call to ask about intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al albergue o llame para preguntar cómo entrar.
records.notes: Christ-centered program. Also offers a 13-month residential addiction recovery program (New Beginnings), transitional supportive housing, and street outreach case management. Intake hours were not listed. Email info@faithmissionwf.org.

records.name: Faith Refuge Women and Children's Shelter
records.description_en: Emergency shelter for women and children with beds, showers, meals, clothing, and case management.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia para mujeres y niños, con cama, regadera, comida, ropa y apoyo de un trabajador de casos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For women and children who are homeless in Wichita Falls.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres y niños sin hogar en Wichita Falls.
records.how_to_apply: Call the shelter to ask about space and intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al albergue para preguntar si hay espacio y cómo entrar.
records.notes: Intake hours were not listed on the page.

records.name: The Salvation Army Wichita Falls
records.description_en: The Salvation Army office in Wichita Falls helps people in need. Call to ask what help is available now.
records.description_es: La oficina del Ejército de Salvación en Wichita Falls ayuda a personas con necesidad. Llame para preguntar qué ayuda hay ahora.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in Wichita Falls.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con necesidad en Wichita Falls.
records.how_to_apply: Call the office to ask what help is available now.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina para preguntar qué ayuda hay disponible ahora.
records.notes: Corps (church) location: 2900 Seymour Hwy. The official page confirmed the office address and phone but did not list specific services (shelter, food, rent/utility) or hours; call first.

records.name: The Salvation Army Sherman
records.description_en: Offers emergency financial help, shelter services, and a food pantry.
records.description_es: Ofrece ayuda económica de emergencia, servicios de albergue y una despensa de comida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in the Sherman area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con necesidad en el área de Sherman.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Sherman Corps to ask for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina del Ejército de Salvación en Sherman para pedir ayuda.
records.notes: Hours for assistance were not listed. Family Thrift Store: 426 W. Houston St., Mon-Sat 10 AM-4 PM.

records.name: Grayson Crisis Center
records.description_en: Helps survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault with a 24/7 hotline, emergency shelter, housing help, crisis counseling, and advocacy.
records.description_es: Ayuda a sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica y agresión sexual con una línea de crisis las 24 horas, albergue de emergencia, ayuda con vivienda, consejería y acompañamiento.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of domestic violence or sexual assault in Grayson County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica o agresión sexual en el condado de Grayson.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 hotline for immediate help, or call the main office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis las 24 horas para recibir ayuda de inmediato, o llame a la oficina principal.
records.notes: 24/7 hotline (903) 893-5615 (listed for sexual assault survivors); main office (903) 893-3909. Office address 4200 N Travis St., Sherman, TX 75092 is published on the site, but shelter locations are confidential - do not share shelter addresses.

records.name: WIC - Wichita Falls-Wichita County Public Health District
records.organization: City of Wichita Falls / Wichita Falls-Wichita County Public Health District
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition advice, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC da comida saludable, consejos de nutrición y apoyo para dar pecho a mujeres embarazadas, mamás que acaban de dar a luz, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, infants, and children under 5 who meet WIC income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen con los límites de ingreso de WIC.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text the WIC office to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un mensaje de texto a la oficina de WIC para hacer una cita.

records.name: Wichita Falls-Wichita County Public Health District
records.description_en: The local public health district offers personal health services and WIC.
records.description_es: El distrito de salud pública local ofrece servicios de salud personal y WIC.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Wichita Falls and Wichita County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Wichita Falls y del condado de Wichita.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Health District to ask about services and appointments.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al Distrito de Salud para preguntar por los servicios y hacer una cita.
records.notes: Personal Health Services line: (940) 761-7892. The street address and hours of the clinic were not confirmed.

records.name: Grayson County WIC
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC da comida saludable, ayuda con la nutrición y apoyo para dar pecho a mujeres embarazadas, mamás que acaban de dar a luz, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, infants, and children under 5 in Grayson County who meet WIC rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños menores de 5 años en el condado de Grayson que cumplen con las reglas de WIC.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Sherman or Denison WIC clinic to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica de WIC en Sherman o en Denison para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8:00 AM-7:00 PM (closed 1:00-2:00 PM for lunch)
records.notes: Sherman phone ext. 1238. Denison clinic: 205 N Houston St., Denison, (903) 465-2878 ext. 1338, same hours.

records.name: Grayson County Health Department Clinic
records.description_en: The county health department offers clinic services, immunization records, and WIC.
records.description_es: El departamento de salud del condado ofrece servicios de clínica, vacunas, registros de vacunas y WIC.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Grayson County residents.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Grayson.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Sherman office to ask about clinic services and costs.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de Sherman para preguntar por los servicios de la clínica y los costos.
records.cost: Fees vary; prices subject to change
records.notes: Denison office: 205 North Houston, (903) 465-2878.

records.name: Hunt County Health Clinic (Immunizations and Adult Safety Net)
records.description_en: The county clinic gives low- or no-cost child vaccines, adult vaccines for uninsured adults through the Adult Safety Net program, and TB testing.
records.description_es: La clínica del condado pone vacunas a niños a bajo costo o gratis, vacunas a adultos sin seguro médico con el programa Adult Safety Net, y hace pruebas de tuberculosis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Child vaccines are for eligible children; Adult Safety Net vaccines are for uninsured adults age 19 and older.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Las vacunas para niños son para niños que califican. Las vacunas de Adult Safety Net son para adultos de 19 años o más sin seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic for appointments, hours, and fees.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita y preguntar el horario y los costos.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8:00 AM-5:00 PM; Friday 8:30 AM-4:00 PM
records.notes: Child vaccines through the Texas Vaccines for Children Program. Adult Safety Net is only for uninsured adults 19+ (not for people with Medicare, Medicaid, or other coverage). Most private insurance accepted for vaccines. Saturday appointments on the first Saturday of the month by request.

records.name: Helen Farabee Centers
records.description_en: The local mental health authority offers treatment and support for serious mental illness, substance use, and intellectual and developmental disabilities, plus a 24/7 crisis line.
records.description_es: Es la autoridad local de salud mental. Ofrece tratamiento y apoyo para enfermedades mentales graves, uso de drogas o alcohol, y discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo. Tiene una línea de crisis las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in its service area, including Wichita County, who need mental health, substance use, or IDD services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en su área de servicio, incluido el condado de Wichita, que necesitan servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main office to start services, or call the 24/7 crisis line in an emergency.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina principal para empezar los servicios, o llame a la línea de crisis las 24 horas si es una emergencia.
records.notes: 24/7 crisis line: 1-800-621-8504. Adult behavioral health, substance use, veterans and crisis center: 500 Broad Street, Wichita Falls, (940) 397-3300. Children and adolescents: 516 Denver Street, (940) 720-3500. Early Childhood Intervention: 1709 10th St, (940) 696-6200.

records.name: Texoma Community Center
records.description_en: Provides mental health and substance use care for children, teens, and adults, plus intellectual and developmental disability services.
records.description_es: Da atención de salud mental y de uso de drogas o alcohol para niños, jóvenes y adultos, y servicios para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Cooke, Fannin, and Grayson counties. No one is turned away for inability to pay; fees are based on income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los condados de Cooke, Fannin y Grayson. Atienden a todos aunque no puedan pagar; hay descuentos según el ingreso y el tamaño de la familia.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Sherman office during business hours, or call the crisis line anytime.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o vaya a la oficina de Sherman en horario de atención, o llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora.
records.notes: Crisis line: (877) 277-2226 (24 hours). Toll free: (877) 530-2228.

records.name: Pecan Valley Centers - Weatherford
records.description_en: Offers mental health, substance use, and developmental disability services, including assessment, counseling, and youth services.
records.description_es: Ofrece servicios de salud mental, uso de drogas o alcohol y discapacidades del desarrollo, incluidas evaluaciones, consejería y servicios para jóvenes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Johnson, Somervell, Hood, Erath, Parker, and Palo Pinto counties. Fees use a sliding scale and no one is denied for inability to pay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los condados de Johnson, Somervell, Hood, Erath, Parker y Palo Pinto. El costo depende del ingreso y nadie se queda sin atención por no poder pagar.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit Weatherford Intake for an assessment and referral.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o vaya a la oficina de admisión (Intake) de Weatherford para una evaluación y referencia.
records.notes: 24/7 crisis hotline: 1-800-772-5987; IDD intake: 1-866-948-7198. Weatherford Clinic (counseling): 1715 Santa Fe Dr, (817) 599-7634, late hours Mondays until 7 PM. Youth Services: 114 North Waco St, (817) 594-3052.

records.name: Lakes Regional Community Center - Hunt County
records.description_en: Provides mental health, substance use, intellectual and developmental disability, and early childhood intervention services.
records.description_es: Ofrece servicios de salud mental, uso de drogas o alcohol, discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo, e intervención temprana para niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in its 10-county area, which includes Hunt County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en sus 10 condados de servicio, incluido el condado de Hunt.
records.how_to_apply: Call the non-emergency line to find the nearest location and start services; for a crisis in Hunt County call the NTBHA crisis hotline.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea que no es de emergencia para encontrar la oficina más cercana y empezar los servicios. Si tiene una crisis en el condado de Hunt, llame a la línea de crisis de NTBHA.
records.cost: Sliding scale; help even if unable to pay
records.notes: Hunt County 24/7 crisis line: NTBHA Crisis Hotline (866) 260-8000. Sliding fee scale; help even if you cannot pay. A specific Greenville office address was not confirmed.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Wichita Falls Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help with eviction and housing, family law and domestic violence, debt, public benefits, wills, and more.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles: desalojos y vivienda, asuntos de familia y violencia doméstica, deudas, beneficios públicos, testamentos y más.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people in the organization's 114-county service area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos en los 114 condados que atiende la organización.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea o llame a la Línea de Ayuda Legal al 1-888-529-5277.
records.notes: Toll-free for this office: (800) 926-5542. Main intake: 1-888-529-5277. Online application is in English and Spanish; cases with deadlines, lawsuits, divorce, custody, or family violence must call the Legal Aid Line instead.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Weatherford Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help with eviction and housing, family law and domestic violence, debt, public benefits, wills, and more.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles: desalojos y vivienda, asuntos de familia y violencia doméstica, deudas, beneficios públicos, testamentos y más.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people in the organization's 114-county service area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos en los 114 condados que atiende la organización.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea o llame a la Línea de Ayuda Legal al 1-888-529-5277.
records.notes: Toll-free for this office: (800) 967-6708. Main intake: 1-888-529-5277. Online application is in English and Spanish; cases with deadlines, lawsuits, divorce, custody, or family violence must call the Legal Aid Line instead.

records.name: Workforce Solutions North Texas - Wichita Falls
records.description_en: Free job search help, skills training, vocational rehabilitation, and veteran services.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, capacitación, rehabilitación vocacional y servicios para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in 11 North Texas counties: Archer, Baylor, Clay, Cottle, Foard, Hardeman, Jack, Montague, Wichita, Wilbarger, and Young.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en 11 condados del norte de Texas: Archer, Baylor, Clay, Cottle, Foard, Hardeman, Jack, Montague, Wichita, Wilbarger y Young.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Wichita Falls office or call for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la oficina de Wichita Falls o llame para pedir ayuda.

records.name: Child Care Services (CCS) Scholarships
records.description_en: Helps pay for child care so parents can work, go to school, or train for a job.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse para un trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texas families with a child under 13 (or under 19 with a disability) who meet work, school, and income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de Texas con un niño menor de 13 años (o menor de 19 con discapacidad) que cumplen con requisitos de trabajo, estudio e ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas child care portal, then send paperwork by upload, email, fax, or the drop box at the Galaxy Center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en el portal de cuidado infantil de Texas. Después mande sus documentos por el portal, por correo electrónico, por fax o en el buzón del Galaxy Center.
records.cost: Parent pays a share based on income
records.notes: There is a waitlist; waits generally range from 6 months to a year. Fax: (940) 723-1818. Child must be a U.S. citizen or have legal immigration status.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Texoma - Grayson County (Denison)
records.description_en: Free job search help, career training, and child care assistance.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, capacitación y ayuda con el cuidado de niños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers and families in Grayson, Cooke, and Fannin counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo y familias en los condados de Grayson, Cooke y Fannin.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Denison office or call for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la oficina de Denison o llame para pedir ayuda.
records.notes: Phone listed as the Grayson County office number on the child care page. Child care income limits not stated on the page.

records.name: Weatherford Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Free help for job seekers, training resources, and child care help for families.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para quienes buscan trabajo, recursos de capacitación y ayuda con el cuidado de niños para familias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers and families in Parker and Palo Pinto counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo y familias en los condados de Parker y Palo Pinto.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center or call; services are also offered by phone, email, and online.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al centro o llame. También atienden por teléfono, correo electrónico y en línea.
records.notes: Email: weatherfordworkforce@dfwjobs.com.

records.name: Greenville Workforce Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for North Central Texas
records.description_en: Free help for job seekers, training resources, and child care help for families.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para quienes buscan trabajo, recursos de capacitación y ayuda con el cuidado de niños para familias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers and families in Hunt County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo y familias en el condado de Hunt.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center or call; services are also offered by phone, email, and online.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al centro o llame. También atienden por teléfono, correo electrónico y en línea.
records.notes: Email: greenvilleworkforce@dfwjobs.com.

records.name: TAPS Public Transit Demand-Response Rides
records.description_en: Curb-to-curb rides you book ahead, to work, medical visits, school, and errands. Seniors 60+, people with disabilities, and students pay reduced fares, and veterans ride free.
records.description_es: Viajes de puerta a puerta que se reservan con anticipación, para ir al trabajo, a citas médicas, a la escuela o a hacer mandados. Personas mayores de 60, personas con discapacidad y estudiantes pagan menos, y los veteranos viajan gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the general public in the TAPS service area. Reduced fares for seniors 60+, people with disabilities, and students; free rides for verified veterans.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público en general en el área de servicio de TAPS. Tarifas reducidas para mayores de 60 años, personas con discapacidad y estudiantes; viajes gratis para veteranos verificados.
records.how_to_apply: Call at least 48 hours before your trip to schedule a ride.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame por lo menos 48 horas antes de su viaje para reservarlo.
records.notes: TAPS describes itself as a regional provider in the Texoma area based in Sherman; its exact county list was not stated on the pages read.

records.name: Wichita Falls Public Transportation
records.description_en: The city runs public transportation in Wichita Falls.
records.description_es: La ciudad ofrece transporte público en Wichita Falls.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For riders in Wichita Falls.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para pasajeros en Wichita Falls.
records.how_to_apply: Call the city's public transportation office for routes, fares, and reduced-fare or paratransit options.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de transporte público de la ciudad para preguntar por rutas, tarifas, tarifas reducidas o transporte para personas con discapacidad.
records.notes: Only the phone number was confirmed (city staff directory). Fares, reduced fares, and paratransit details were not confirmed. Travel center: (940) 761-7925.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging of Texoma
records.description_en: Helps older adults and people with disabilities with benefits counseling (including Medicare), care coordination, caregiver support, nutrition services, and ombudsman help.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas mayores y personas con discapacidad con información sobre beneficios (incluido Medicare), coordinación de cuidados, apoyo para cuidadores, servicios de nutrición y defensa de residentes de asilos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people age 60 and older and people with disabilities in Cooke, Fannin, and Grayson counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más y personas con discapacidad en los condados de Cooke, Fannin y Grayson.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Information, Referral and Assistance line or email TCOG.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de Información, Referencia y Ayuda o mande un correo electrónico a TCOG.
records.notes: Toll-free (800) 677-8264. Email info@texoma.cog.tx.us. Also home to the ADRC (Aging and Disability Resource Center) of Texoma. Medicare Open Enrollment help appointments Oct 15-Dec 7.

records.name: Grayson County Veterans Services Office
records.description_en: Helps veterans and their families learn about and apply for VA benefits and other resources.
records.description_es: Ayuda a veteranos y sus familias a conocer y solicitar beneficios del VA y otros recursos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For veterans and their dependents in Grayson County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para veteranos y sus familiares en el condado de Grayson.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Veterans Services Office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos.

records.name: Hunt County Veterans Services Office
records.description_en: Helps veterans and their dependents apply for benefits from the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and the Texas Veterans Commission.
records.description_es: Ayuda a veteranos y sus familiares a solicitar beneficios del Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos de EE. UU. y de la Comisión de Veteranos de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For veterans and their dependents in Hunt County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para veteranos y sus familiares en el condado de Hunt.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Veterans Services Office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos.

records.name: North Texas Area United Way (2-1-1, Free Tax Prep, Family Programs)
records.description_en: Connects people to local help through 2-1-1, offers free tax preparation (VITA), and runs family programs like Help Me Grow and home visiting.
records.description_es: Le conecta con ayuda local por medio del 2-1-1, ofrece preparación de impuestos gratis (VITA) y tiene programas para familias como Help Me Grow y visitas al hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families and residents in the Wichita Falls area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias y residentes del área de Wichita Falls.
records.how_to_apply: Call the office or dial 2-1-1 for referrals.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina o marque 2-1-1 para recibir referencias.
records.notes: Email info@ntauw.org. Programs include Help Me Grow! Wichita County, Texas Home Visiting, VITA free taxes (seasonal), and the Wichita County Parent Talk Line.
